edits: add 2,3-difluoro on quinone ring of quinoxaline-5,8-dione
accepted.hypothesis: D05 has the highest f (1.09) but O2 margin is -0.054. D09 shows ring fluorination gives margin +0.178 with f=0.86 and no detachment (K084 F4-BQ binds CO2 strongly, K123 quinoxalinedione binds). Adding F2 to the pyrazine-fused quinone should lift margin above 0.15 while the N-heteroaryl scaffold keeps strong binding, so f may rise toward 2. Avoids CN (D03/D07/D12 detached) and amino/OH (D01/D04/D06 f<-1).

edits: add 2,3-dichloro on quinone ring of quinoxaline-5,8-dione
accepted.hypothesis: Cl substitution raised margin in D08 (0.097) and D18 (0.346) with f staying positive and no detachment. Two Cl on the high-f pyrazine-quinone (D05) should add about 0.15-0.2 V margin, with binding preserved by the N-heterocycle. Cl count is limited to 2 because D08 to D18 to D13 shows f falling as halogen count increases. Cl-quinones also have CO2-adduct and moderate binding evidence (K008, K056).

edits: replace two F with Cl at 2,6 positions (mixed Cl2F2 benzoquinone)
accepted.hypothesis: D09 (F4) meets the margin (0.178) but f is 0.86, and D08 (Cl2, f=1.04) has higher f but lower margin. A mixed Cl2F2 benzoquinone keeps the F-driven margin and borrows the 2,6-Cl pattern that gave higher f. Full per-chloro D18 lost f (0.63), so only two Cl are used. Chloranil and F4-BQ are CO2-adduct formers (K029, K084).

edits: add one F on each pyridine ring of the phenanthroline-dione
accepted.hypothesis: D10 (f=0.56, margin -0.010) beats the carbocyclic analog D21 (f=0.71 vs margin -0.196) on margin, so ring N raises margin without detachment. N placement near the 1,2-dione gives strong binding (-25 kcal-like bind) and K110/K117 show high binding constants for this class. Adding F to the pyridines should withdraw electron density, add roughly 0.15-0.2 V margin, and keep binding; f could reach above 1.

edits: replace 2,3-diphenyl on pyrazine with 2,3-difluoro
accepted.hypothesis: D19, D14 and D05 form a high-f series (0.86-1.09) that all have margin near zero. Aryl groups (D19 margin 0.076, D14 -0.002) do not help much. Swapping them for F on the pyrazine should add electron withdrawal and lift margin above 0.15, and removes the steric bulk that may weaken binding. The quinoxalinedione core has strong measured binding (K124, K123). CN-type detachment is avoided because F is much less withdrawing than CN.

edits: add a single F on the pyrazine ring of quinoxaline-5,8-dione, leaving the quinone C=C unsubstituted
accepted.hypothesis: Two things from the data point the same way. Halogens placed on the quinone ring of D05 raised margin but lowered f (F2: 1.09 to 0.77; Cl2: 0.65). Pyrazine-ring substitution in D19 kept f high (0.86 to 0.97 with F2) and still moved margin up. A single F on the pyrazine ring should lift margin from -0.054 toward +0.05 to +0.10 while keeping the strong CO2 binding of the N-heteroaryl quinone (D05 bind -27.6; K123/K124 high binding constants). It is untested whether one F is enough to reach 0.15 V, but it tests the direction with the smallest f penalty. Avoids CN (D03/D07/D12 detached) and quinone-ring halogens that lowered f.

edits: add 2,3-dichloro on the pyrazine ring, keeping the quinone C=C-H unsubstituted
accepted.hypothesis: Quinone-ring Cl2 on D05 gave margin 0.22 but f fell to 0.65. D19 shows that pyrazine-side substituents retain f (0.86 to 0.97 with F2). Moving the Cl2 off the quinone ring onto the pyrazine ring should keep the bound CO2 geometry at the quinone O atoms and still withdraw electrons. Cl gave a larger margin gain than F in the D05 pair, so this may clear 0.15 V while f stays near D05 (about 1.0). Two Cl are used because D08 to D18 to D13 shows f drops as halogen count grows.

edits: benzo-fuse the pyrazine ring to give phenazine-1,4-dione
add 7,8-difluoro on the distal benzo ring
accepted.hypothesis: Larger aromatic substituents on the pyrazine (D19 phenyl f 0.86, D14 anisyl f 0.97) kept f high and left binding at -25 to -27 kcal/mol, so extending conjugation on that side does not hurt binding. Fusing a benzo ring keeps the N atoms next to the carbonyl and adds electron delocalisation, which should raise f through stronger binding. The distal F2 sits far from the quinone carbonyls, so it should add margin without removing the f gain, unlike the quinone-ring F that cut f in D05 to D09-type edits. Test of whether remote fluorination can lift margin from about 0 to 0.15 V.

edits: replace the fused benzo-type ring with a second pyrazine (pyrazino[2,3-b]quinoxaline-type tetra-aza core)
no halogen on the quinone ring
accepted.hypothesis: D10 (N-containing phenanthrenequinone) shifted margin by +0.19 V versus its carbocyclic analog D21 (-0.010 vs -0.196) with no detachment and binding of about -25 kcal/mol, and K110 reports a high binding constant for the N-containing dione. Adding ring N atoms is therefore a margin lever that is not CN-like, and the N-heteroaryl scaffold is what gives D05 its f of 1.09. Putting more ring N atoms into the D05 core should raise the margin by at least 0.15 V while the N next to the carbonyl keeps binding strong. This avoids the halogen-count f penalty seen in D13 and D18.

edits: replace one Cl of 2,6-dichloro-p-benzoquinone with F (2-chloro-6-fluoro-p-benzoquinone)
accepted.hypothesis: D08 (Cl2, f 1.04, margin 0.097) is the only benzoquinone with f above 1, and f falls as halogens are added (D18 0.63, D13 0.22, D09 0.86). The previous Cl2F2 try (f 0.76, margin 0.25) shows that mixed halogens give margin to spare, so one fewer halogen may be affordable. Swapping one Cl for F keeps two halogens, so the f penalty from halogen count is avoided. F is the stronger margin lever in D09 (0.178), and K084 shows F-quinones bind CO2. Expected margin is 0.15 V or higher with f near 1.

edits: tetra-aza pyrazino[2,3-b]quinoxaline core
add one F on the distal pyrazine
accepted.hypothesis: Tetra-aza D05 core gave margin 0.18 with f 1.07 and no detachment, so extra ring N is a margin lever. A single pyrazine F raised f in the D05 series (1.09 to 1.24) while moving margin up. Combining them tests whether f rises while margin stays above 0.15. edits: tetra-aza pyrazino[2,3-b]quinoxaline core
add 2,3-difluoro on the distal pyrazine
accepted.hypothesis: The tetra-aza core gave the best margin and f pair so far (0.18, 1.07). Remote F2 on the far pyrazine adds withdrawal, as in D19 where pyrazine-side F2 raised f from 0.86 to 0.97. Fluorination far from the carbonyls should keep the CO2 binding at the quinone O atoms (K084 shows F-quinones bind CO2). Tests whether margin can grow without the f loss seen for quinone-ring halogens. Avoids CN.

edits: add a single Cl on the pyrazine ring, quinone C=C-H left unsubstituted
accepted.hypothesis: Mono-F on the pyrazine gave f 1.24 and margin 0.03. Pyrazine Cl2 gave margin 0.17 but f 0.89. Cl is the stronger margin lever per atom and a single halogen is the smaller f penalty (D08 to D18 to D13 shows f falls with halogen count). One Cl should land between the two and may give f above 1.2 with margin near 0.1. Cl-quinones show CO2 binding (K008, K056). No CN, no amino/OH, which lowered f in D01/D04/D06.

edits: replace the pyrazine with a pyridine ring (quinoline-5,8-dione core)
add one F on the pyridine ring
accepted.hypothesis: D05 f comes from the ring N next to the carbonyl (bind -27.6). Keeping one N but adding F tests whether a lighter heteroaryl with a single remote F gives f near the 1.24 of the mono-F pyrazine. D10 vs D21 shows ring N adds margin without detachment, and K110 shows a high binding constant for the N-heterocyclic dione. A single pyridine F is far from the carbonyls and adds withdrawal without the quinone-ring halogen f penalty.

edits: benzo-fuse the pyrazine of quinoxaline-5,8-dione
replace one distal CH with N (pyrido-fused, aza-phenazine-1,4-dione)
add one F next to the distal ring N
accepted.hypothesis: Two directions raised f in the DFT data. Pyrazine-side substitution on the D05 core kept f at or above 1 (D19 0.86, D14 0.97; the pyrazine-F analog reached f 1.24). The tetra-aza core reached margin 0.18 with f 1.07. Ring N atoms away from the carbonyls lifted margin by about 0.19 V in D10 versus D21, with no CO2 detachment. Quinone-ring halogens cut f (D05 to F2 and Cl2 variants: f 0.65-0.77), so this proposal avoids them. The aza-phenazinedione keeps the N,N pocket beside the carbonyls (K123/K124 report strong binding with log K of 9-11), so binding stays near -27 kcal/mol. The distal aza plus F pair should add margin of 0.15 V or more. The difluoro-phenazine analog had f 1.19 and margin -0.018. The extra N should supply the missing margin, and one F rather than two limits the halogen-count f penalty (D18, D13). Whether f can approach 2 is untested; DFT will decide. Avoids CN, amino and OH, which detached or gave f below -1.

edits: move one Cl of 2,6-dichloro-p-benzoquinone to give the 2,5-dichloro isomer

A positional test of the halogen-count rule; it avoids the f loss from more halogens and any CN group.
